author: (Dall, 1896)

note.en: A clam of about 2 mm, one of the smallest on the list. Three museum specimens come from 7 to 24 m at Cahuita and Manzanillo, found only by sieving sediment.
note.es: Una almeja de unos 2 mm, una de las más pequeñas de la lista. Tres ejemplares de museo vienen de 7 a 24 m en Cahuita y Manzanillo, y solo se encuentran tamizando sedimento.

evidence: GBIF: 3 preserved specimen(s) in the region (INBio Atta collection, 1999 to 2001)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection and other museum records), Gandoca to Limón
